description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of custom agents
description_zh: 分页列出 自定义 Agent
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-custom-agents --max-results 20 --next-token 12345 --biz-q analysis --visibility TENANT --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomAgents

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Omit this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `NextToken` value from the previous response to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token。首次查询不传；后续查询传上一次返回的 `NextToken` 获取下一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for a fuzzy match by agent name
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，按 Agent 名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: q

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by visibility level. You can specify multiple levels
parameters.help_zh: 按可见性级别过滤，可传多个
parameters.name: visibility
